name: load
description: Does the system meet the SLA under expected traffic. Ramp-up / steady / ramp-down; the steady segment is the SLA observation window.
_override: Command-line overrides only apply to scalar keys: this profile's stages are literals, so to change the target rate edit this file or copy a variant. Rate tiers should be derived from real production traffic; record the derivation here. Thresholds are evaluated over the whole run (including ramp segments), not just the steady segment.

thresholds._circuitBreaker: Two-tier lines: the strict line is the end-of-run verdict; the lenient line + abortOnFail is the breaker, which only kills the unwinnable case of wholesale business rejection (stale data). The leniency is deliberate — at low throughput, scattered legitimate transient failures must not abort a long run; delayAbortEval lets the sample size accumulate first.
